lead: A `nv splice` block that inserts text before an anchor repeats that anchor on both sides, so fixing a stale `--- old` copy alone silently rewrites that line.
body: The tool matches the OLD side and writes the NEW one verbatim, so an "anchor" is an edit too, and a landed doc comment changes under an insertion that never meant to touch it. Correct both copies, and read the anchor lines out of `git diff` after a splice whose blocks were insertions.
